description_en: Queries the network domains of a specified Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 获取指定堡垒机下的网络域列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-network-domains --instance-id bastionhost-cn-tl329pvu70x --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNetworkDomains

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for paging in a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page for paging in a paged query.  
Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20. If this parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the network domain
parameters.name: network_domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network domain. Valid values:

Direct: direct connection
Proxy: proxy
parameters.help_zh:
网络域类型。取值：

Direct：直连
Proxy：代理
parameters.name: network_domain_type

Comment.description_en: The description of the network domain

Default.description_en:
Indicates whether the network domain is a built-in network domain.

true: yes
false: no
Default.description_zh:
是否为内置网络域。

true：是
false：否

NetworkDomainId.description_en: The ID of the network domain

NetworkDomainName.description_en: The name of the network domain

NetworkDomainType.description_en:
The type of the network domain. Valid values:

Direct: direct connection
Proxy: proxy
NetworkDomainType.description_zh:
网络域类型。取值：

Direct：直连
Proxy：代理

ProxiesState.description_en: The information about the proxy servers

NodeType.description_en:
The type of the proxy server node. Valid values:

Master: primary proxy server
Slave: secondary proxy server
NodeType.description_zh:
代理服务器节点。取值：

Master：主代理服务器
Slave：备代理服务器

ProxyState.description_en:
The status of the proxy server.

Available: available
Unavailable: unavailable
ProxyState.description_zh:
代理服务器状态。

Available：可用
Unavailable：不可用

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of network domains
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的网络域总数量
